COMPARISON ANALYSIS

Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge vs Municipal utility commercial flat plan

Both are commercial rate structures, but they behave very differently. Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge is best for shave peak, while Municipal utility commercial flat plan favors fix billing_error.

Feature Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge Municipal utility commercial flat plan
Rate StructureTOU DEMANDFLAT
Peak Window16:00-21:00 weekdaysNA
Demand Charge BandMIDNONE
Fixed Charge BandMIDLOW
Primary Action LeverSHAVE PEAKFIX BILLING_ERROR
Common MisreadOwners shift load into off-peak hours but restart everything at once, resetting the peak.Owners search a state tariff database that does not hold their municipal utility.

🎯 The Verdict

If your business has high, concentrated usage during peak hours, Municipal utility commercial flat plan will likely save you money. Always verify your specific load profile before requesting a rate change from your utility.
